A note from your daughter

Happy Birthday, Mumma.

We both know we're not always the easiest mother-daughter pair. We don't always see eye to eye, we disagree, we argue, and sometimes I feel like you don't take my side. And I know our bond may look different from the one you share with my sister.

But even with all our little fights and all the things we don't quite understand about each other, there's still that connection. The one that's just there, quietly, because you're my mother and I'm your daughter. Maybe it doesn't always need explaining.

We may not say everything perfectly, and we may not agree on everything, but I hope you know that I do think of you, I care about you, and I wish you happiness, good health, peace, and so many reasons to smile.

So today, I'm sending you these roses — not because we're perfect, but because you're my mum. And that will always mean something to me.

Happy birthday, Mumma. Love you. ♡

MADE WITH LOVE · JUST FOR MUMMA
